machines.title: Lathe
machines.summary: Rotating workpiece and chuck; the main risks are entanglement, flying chips and ejected workpieces.
hazards: Entanglement in rotating chuck or workpiece
hidden_hazards: Bar stock extending past the headstock whips
Long hair, jewellery or loose sleeves
Chuck key left in the chuck

guarding.detail: Interlocked guard that stops the spindle when opened.
Fixed cover over lead screw and gear train.
Transparent guard to stop chips and coolant.

before_start: Check guards are fitted and interlocks working.
Remove chuck key and check workpiece is secure.
Set correct speed and tool height.
Wear safety glasses and tie back hair; no gloves or loose sleeves.
daily_checks: Check emergency stop and foot brake.
Check for oil leaks and clear swarf.
never: Never use a rag or file near rotating work.
Never leave the chuck key in the chuck.
Never brake the chuck by hand.
Never wear gloves, rings or loose clothing.

machines.title: Drill Press
machines.summary: A rotating bit that can catch clothing, hair or a workpiece spinning with the bit.
hidden_hazards: Unclamped workpiece that spins with the bit
Long swarf wrapping around the bit

guarding.detail: Retractable or transparent guard around the chuck.
Fixed guard over belts and pulleys.
Clamps or vice to hold work.

before_start: Clamp the workpiece to table or use a vice.
Set speed for material and bit size.
Remove chuck key.
Wear safety glasses; secure hair and clothing.
daily_checks: Check bit is sharp and straight.
Clear chips with a brush, not by hand.
never: Never hold the work by hand.
Never remove chips while spinning.
Never leave the chuck key in.
Never wear gloves or loose clothing.

machines.title: Bench / Angle Grinder
machines.summary: A high-speed abrasive wheel can burst or kick back and throws sparks and particles.
nip_points: Gap between wheel and tool rest

guarding.detail: Fixed guard covering at least 75% of the wheel.
Adjusted to 2 to 3 mm from the wheel.
Adjustable spark shield and eye shield.

before_start: Ring test: tap the wheel to check for cracks.
Check wheel rating (RPM) is above machine speed.
Check guard, rest and flange are correct.
Let a new wheel run for a minute before use, standing aside.
daily_checks: Inspect wheel for chips or cracks.
Adjust tool rest as the wheel wears.
Check dust extraction and sparks area.
never: Never use a wheel without guard.
Never grind on the side of a straight wheel.
Never use a cracked or damaged wheel.
Never stand in line with the wheel when starting.

machines.title: Conveyor
machines.summary: Moving belts, rollers and pulleys create many nip points and are often cleared or worked on while running.
hazards: Entanglement and drawing-in at nip points

guarding.detail: Cover drive, tail pulley and nip points.
Along the full length of the belt.
Doors and hatches that stop the conveyor.

before_start: Check guards and pull cords.
Make sure the area is clear and people are warned.
Check start alarm and horn work.
Follow lockout procedure for any cleaning or adjustment.
never: Never clean or adjust a moving conveyor.
Never ride or climb on a conveyor.
Never bypass interlocks or guards.
Never work with loose clothing near rollers.

machines.title: Power Press / Press Brake
machines.summary: A stamping press delivers extreme crushing force; point-of-operation guarding is critical.
hazards: Crush and amputation at the die

guarding.detail: Stops the ram when the beam is broken.
Both hands must be clear and away from the die.
Prevents hands entering die area.

before_start: Check light curtains, two-hand controls and e-stop.
Check die is correctly set and fastened.
Verify stopping time and safe distance.
Use hand tools for loading and clearing.
daily_checks: Check hydraulic and air systems for leaks.
never: Never reach into the die area.
Never bypass or tie down controls.
Never work on the press without lockout and die blocks.
Never allow two people to run without separate controls.

bridge.activity: Operating a power press or press brake

machines.title: Circular / Band Saw
machines.summary: Moving blades can cut deeply and cause kickback or workpiece ejection.

guarding.detail: Covers all but the cutting portion; adjust to the work.
Prevents the cut from closing on the blade.
Keeps hands away from the blade.

before_start: Check blade is sharp and correct for the material.
Adjust guard to the work thickness.
Check fence and riving knife.
Wear eye and hearing protection and dust control.
daily_checks: Inspect the blade for cracks or missing teeth.
never: Never remove blade guard.
Never reach across the blade.
Never cut freehand without a fence or guide.
Never clear offcuts while blade is running.

machines.title: Milling Machine
machines.summary: A rotating cutter removes material; the cutter, work table and swarf all present serious hazards.

guarding.detail: Transparent guard around the cutting area.
Enclosed machines stop when door opens.
Fixed guard on drive.

before_start: Secure the work and cutter correctly.
Check speed and feed setting.
Remove spanners and keys.
Wear glasses and tie back hair; no gloves.
never: Never touch the cutter while spinning.
Never leave keys or spanners on the machine.
Never measure or adjust while running.
Never use gloves or loose clothing.

types.name: In-running nip
types.detail: Two parts rotating toward each other draw in clothing or hands.
types.example: Belt over a pulley, conveyor tail roller

types.name: Shear point
types.detail: Moving part passes close to a fixed part and cuts or traps.
types.example: Press ram and bolster, scissor lifts

types.name: Crush point
types.detail: A body part trapped between a moving and fixed part.

types.name: Entanglement point
types.detail: Exposed rotating shaft or spindle catches clothing or hair.

walk_steps: Stop and ensure the machine is isolated before inspection.
Look at every moving part, shaft, belt and gear.
Mark every spot where two parts move toward each other.
Check each nip point is guarded and that the guard is fixed.
Ask what could happen during setup, cleaning and fault clearing.
Record findings and fix the highest-risk first.
tips: Ask whether a hand, sleeve or hair could be drawn in.
Look beyond normal use: maintenance and jams are when injuries happen.
Fixed guards are better than adjustable guards.
Guards must not be removable without a tool.

loto.title: Lockout / Tagout (LOTO)
loto.principle: Isolate every energy source, lock it off, test it, and only then work. Each person applies their own lock and keeps the key.

steps.title: Prepare
do: Identify the machine, energy sources and isolation points.
Tell affected workers and the supervisor.
Gather locks, tags and test equipment.
steps.verify: Written procedure and energy source list are available.

steps.title: Shut down
do: Stop the machine using the normal stop.
Wait for all motion to stop.
steps.verify: All movement has stopped and controls are off.
mistakes: Switching off at the wrong point

steps.title: Isolate
do: Disconnect or block other energy sources.
steps.verify: Every isolation point is in the safe position.

steps.title: Lock and tag
do: Apply your personal lock and tag to each isolation point.
Fill in the tag with name, date and reason.
steps.verify: Each device is locked and tagged.
mistakes: Using one lock for several people
Tagging without a lock where locks are possible

steps.title: Release stored energy
do: Bleed pressure, discharge capacitors, lower or block suspended parts.
Release springs and cool hot parts.
steps.verify: Gauges read zero and parts are blocked.

steps.title: Verify (try-out)
do: Try to start the machine using normal controls.
Test the circuit with a meter where electrical.
steps.verify: Machine does not start and tests show zero energy.

restoration: Remove tools and materials and replace guards.
Each person removes their own lock and tag.
Re-energise and test before returning to service.
rules: One person, one lock, one key.
Never remove another person's lock without a formal authorised procedure.
Never work on equipment unless you have verified zero energy.
Group lockout uses a lock box for each person's lock.
Contractors must follow the site LOTO procedure.

energy_types.isolation: Open the disconnect, lock it, test dead with a meter.
Close valves, relieve pressure, drain accumulators.
Close the air supply, vent the line, lock the valve.
Lower or block parts, release spring tension.
Close valves and let it cool.
Close, blank or double-block and bleed; purge.
